source_delta.guard_contract: Historical replay revalidates selected/shadow route references against method/control exclusion, canonical user visibility, current-turn echo exclusion, unique/count bounds, persisted selected character identity, and selected/shadow context budgets before adaptive learning or replay return.

falsifiers: A persisted replay route for Gabriel that references an Andreas-private factual memory must fail closed before learning or return.
A persisted replay route that references a memory sourced from the active turn must fail closed before learning or return.
A replay route containing duplicate IDs or more IDs than limit_items must fail closed instead of amplifying returned context.
A replay route whose selected/shadow values exceed budget_chars, or whose selected values disagree with chars_selected, must fail closed.
A valid same-user historical route inside limits must remain admissible.

go_experiment_accounting.reason: These were ordinary deterministic mechanism regressions; the global go unusual-experiment slot is coordinated separately and no second unusual experiment is claimed here.
